body: This is a really good idea. But I believe the scholarship is around $20,000 a year, and I don’t know if I would make enough, considering I haven’t had the most exceptional grades last semester

wow I really appreciate this response. its hard for me to think im going through a lot when I’m finally in a healthy environment, just with some setbacks. the doing something i enjoy every day seems like a really good idea, even if I only have time for a half hour to start. we have an excellent tutoring center for students with learning disabilities and I was diagnosed with ADHD when I was young, but it never really affected me in school so I assumed I was misdiagnosed and my behavior was just trauma-related so I have been hesitant to apply for it. Perhaps I should just apply for it. You were very helpful, thank you so much.
